b3ce47a883be6105.answer: {"subreddit":"pettyrevenge","title":"I Gave a Demanding Customer a Free Drill—and It Backfired","script":"The day a customer demanded a free power drill and threatened to call the health inspector, I decided to give them exactly what they wanted. I slipped a cheap, toy-grade drill into the bag, told them it was on the house, and watched their smug grin widen as they marched to the checkout. As soon as they turned it on, the plastic gears jammed and the drill sparked, sending a tiny fireball into the ceiling tile. The store alarm blared, the store manager rushed over, and the fire marshal arrived minutes later, citing a serious safety violation. The angry customer screamed, demanding a refund, but the inspector handed them a citation for attempting to sabotage the store. My manager stepped in, rolled his eyes, and told me to give her the replacement on the house to avoid a scene. I obeyed, watching her smirk as I handed over the steaming cup. She left a massive $100 tip on the counter, then turned around and demanded a refund for the “extra” caffeine she never received. I handed her the cash, and as she walked out, she tossed a note that read “Thanks for the free drink, enjoy the money.” The twist?
